PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.issue: No operator/owner auth — any caller can mint 39007 for any pubkey
PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.minimalFix: Require ROOT/operator attested authEvent with purpose ISSUE_GLOBAL_CERT + evidence checks; refuse anonymous issue

PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.issue: Unauthenticated bind of unbound phone to arbitrary pubkey
PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.minimalFix: Require authenticated owner proof + uniqueness; keep PHONE_REBIND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED until product flow exists

PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.issue: Auth checks only ROOT pubkey signature — missing kind/purpose/target/freshness binding (replay risk)
PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.minimalFix: Require fresh single-purpose authEvent bound to targetPubkey+status+expiry; reject reuse

PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.issue: Global disable tip not published/fetched; boot/login paths can skip assertLoginAllowed
PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.minimalFix: Publish 39008 to relays; client reconcile on boot before SessionAuthority bind; fail-closed if modules missing

PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.issue: redeemerPubkey taken from body without signature proving key possession
PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.minimalFix: Require redeemer-signed challenge/authEvent bound to inviteId

PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.issue: COMMUNITY/legacy invite, invite-off, auth.html email flow can create accounts without phone binding
PHASE_A_BLOCKERS.minimalFix: Product policy: keep legacy login; close or clearly label non-phone NEW registration paths if phone-mandatory for new global accounts
